code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows severe hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is mild hypoalbuminemia, low total protein, and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest acute or chronic illness with possible infection/inflammation, impaired oxygenation, and risk of bleeding. Close clinical monitoring and further evaluation are recommended.
